questions.text: Who are you, and what would you like the application to know about you?
What are you working on and what do you want help with?
How should the application speak to you?
How much detail do you prefer?
Which language or languages do you want to use?
Are there attention, organization or ADHD-related needs you want accommodated? You can leave this unanswered.
Give examples of things you want the application to remember.
Give examples of things the application should not know, ask about or infer.
Which categories may be stored, at what detail and sensitivity, sent to which providers, inferred or kept only when stated explicitly? What retention do you choose?
